title: Lakshmi Ashtottara Shatanamavali Meaning: Names 21-24 (Aditi, Diti, Dipta, Vasudha)
desc: Meaning of Goddess Lakshmi's 108 names, numbers 21 to 24: Aditi, Diti, Dipta, Vasudha, with a short note on each.
alt: Goddess Lakshmi, 108 names 21 to 24 with meaning
caption: Names 21 to 24 of the 108 names of Lakshmi.
intro: The **108 names of Goddess Lakshmi (Ashtottara Shatanamavali)** are chanted on Fridays and at Diwali and Varalakshmi Vratham. This post explains **names 21 to 24**: **Aditi, Diti, Dipta, Vasudha**.
takeaways: Each name describes one quality of Lakshmi: Aditi, Diti, Dipta, Vasudha.
Fridays are the traditional day for Lakshmi names.
Say each name with 'Om' before and 'Namah' after.

p: **Aditi** means **The Boundless**. Aditi is the boundless mother of the devas; Lakshmi is praised with the same name.
**Diti** means **Associated with Diti**. Diti is the mother of the daityas. Commentators read this as: her grace is for all.
**Dipta** means **The Shining One**. She shines like a lamp that never goes out.
**Vasudha** means **Earth that gives wealth**. The earth gives grain, water and metals; she is seen as the bounty of the Earth.
Offer flowers or kumkum at each name if you can, saying 'Om', the name, then 'Namah'. If time is short, chant a few names a day and complete the 108 over the week.

faq.q: How many names does Lakshmi Ashtottara have?
faq.a: **108** names, which is why it is called Ashtottara Shatanamavali.

faq.q: Which day is best for Lakshmi names?
faq.a: **Friday**, and festival days like Diwali and Varalakshmi Vratham.
